roadmap.title: Story first: Chapters 1–2
roadmap.note: Play the story and do the Chapter 1 meditation — it may be missable.

roadmap.title: Story: Chapters 3–5
roadmap.note: Finish the story; free roam carries on after the credits.

roadmap.title: Character questlines
roadmap.note: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — all still open after the story.

roadmap.title: Activities & collectibles
roadmap.note: Stunts, ranges, races, cards, scans and challenges.

roadmap.title: Robberies, crime & money
roadmap.note: Vaults, shops, tanks, jets, gangs and property.

roadmap.title: Hidden trophies & the platinum
roadmap.note: The five vague trophies, the 100% checklist and the platinum itself.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — no online play and no DLC needed.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.
Everything is single-player, so no online trophy or DLC trophy stands between you and the platinum.

audit.reason: Pops automatically once every other trophy is earned.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The first story trophy. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
It is automatic and cannot be missed — just play the story.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops a little late, once you start the first mission of Chapter 2.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 1; the trophy unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops once the next chapter gets going.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2; the trophy arrives after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3; the trophy unlocks after Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two missions of Chapter 4.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops after the final mission of the chapter.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4; the trophy unlocks after the final main mission, Starting From Zero.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Free roam carries on after the credits, so the cleanup starts here.

steps.text: Complete the final story mission; the gold trophy pops with the ending.
After the credits you keep free roam, so every other trophy can still be earned.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run; the trophy pops during it.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops during it.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play; the trophy pops during it.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners; the trophy pops during it.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown; the trophy pops during it.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops during it.
Story trophy, automatic and unmissable.

audit.reason: Automatic story trophy; it pops as you play and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it is still the longest trophy by far.

steps.text: After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion; progress made during the story already counts.
Complete any 100 optional missions; there are far more than 100, so missed ones do not matter.
Scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app and study any 100 of the 255 animals through the binoculars.
Finish every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest — those need the full set.
Complete any 70 of the 80 challenges; you may skip the ten hardest.
Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything can be done in free roam after the story.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to pile them up.

steps.text: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four kinds as you like.
The four kinds are 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest; the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed.
Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.
The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Most of them happen on their own while you play.

steps.text: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Check what is left under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities.
You will do one of each automatically while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges.

steps.text: Win a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges.
Each range has challenges in three difficulty tiers; some stay locked until you meet their conditions.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough here.
Some locations charge an entry fee.
The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 to choose from, and repeating one does not count.

steps.text: Win 20 different races; there are 40 race locations to choose from.
Winning the same race again does not count — it has to be 20 different ones.
Track them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, then Racing.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. His questline starts after you meet him in Chapter 1.

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline, then beat him in his challenge.
Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg; fish in the marked area until you land one big enough.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Pick whichever of the four you like best.

steps.text: There are 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
The first three are on the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around Leonida.
To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her strand is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3.

steps.text: While playing as Lucia in Chapter 3, Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville.
Complete all five Andy quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The last quest, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy; the strand stays available after the story.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — Maritime Disputes. Dive seven shipwrecks and bring the treasure back.

steps.text: Kenton's strand starts in Chapter 1; after the Island Dreams mission he calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
He marks purple treasure chest icons on the map; dive to the shipwrecks and use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor.
Clear 7 shipwrecks in total for his questline.
After Chapter 1 Kenton goes quiet, then texts Jason again in Chapter 2 or 3, so the strand is not missable.
Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — Hometown Heroes — at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.

steps.text: Billy's strand is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all five Billy jobs: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
The last job, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy; the strand stays available after the story.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count — check the trophy counter as you go.

steps.text: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands; only some optional questlines count toward this trophy.
Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count — Kirk's Skunk Ape strand, Kyle's farm strand, Yago's racing strand and Pete's deliveries.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count; they have their own trophies or are not strangers.
Watch the trophy's progress counter in the trophy list after each strand you finish.
No stranger strand is needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy: deliver all 16 sports cars on his wish list.

steps.text: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner.
He wants 16 sports cars, delivered to his garage in west Vice City, marked by the green RK icon.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list.
Hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to find them; cars in better condition pay more.
He marks cars for you automatically, and marks new ones once you deliver the ones he asked for.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone: shut the synthetic labs down. Jason-only.

steps.text: Tyrone's strand starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason.
Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City, in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest.
Once enough labs are gone, his last job, Spin On This, shuts the labs down and awards the trophy.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. One meditation in Chapter 1 may be missable — do it when it appears.

steps.text: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditate at each one.
In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation — it is gone after Chapter 1.
Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, so bring your partner.
You cannot do the last meditation until both characters are playable together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations; the 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18.

audit.reason: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason-only; the exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

steps.text: Bret's strand starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks it off.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks, marked with purple icons, and bring them back as Jason.
Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. You do not need all of them.

steps.text: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets.
Track each set under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards.
The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this trophy comes on the way.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Any 100 count — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures or tags.

steps.text: Scan WAiNK spots with the phone app by holding Up, then R1; any 100 count.
The spots are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
Track them under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.

steps.text: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges; there are 10 more than needed, so pick the easiest.
View and track them under Progress, then Challenges.
The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easy way out.

steps.text: Wait until after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when Jason and Lucia can roam together; call your partner with hold Right, then Triangle.
Get a 4-star wanted level — causing carnage until the fourth star appears is enough.
Escape through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County; cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you.
The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks by itself while robbing vaults.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level.

steps.text: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner, then rob 3 shops in a row while still wanted.
Keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted level the whole time; dropping to the red heat zone alone breaks the chain.
Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items; loot a few items in each shop and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs.
The 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well; they open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning them with WAiNK is enough — you do not have to drive them.

steps.text: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then R1 while looking at a vehicle.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; there are 557 vehicles in the game.
Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles; the 100% checklist needs 200 base models.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Gang members count; police, soldiers and civilians do not.

steps.text: Activate Combat Focus with L3 and R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar.
Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a wash at home, and use Adrenaline to make it last longer.
Line up 5 gang enemies — the thugs at illegal gang operations work well — and drop them without missing.
Cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count, so pick gang members.
Use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556; it is more accurate than pistols and SMGs and fires full-auto.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a docked airliner and fly 1 km away.

steps.text: At VCIA, steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal's boarding bridge; planes parked on the airfield do not count.
The easiest plane is at departure terminals E3 and E4; drive through a fence and use the stairs by the boarding bridge.
Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane back to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy is delayed and pops once you are far enough.
You can also walk in through the airport terminal on foot, though the airfield route is faster.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station and drive it out.

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the base.
Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then get into a tank.
Shoot enemies from the tank until the trophy pops; driving one off brings a 3-star wanted level.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Snap Gun is the key — never kick the door.

steps.text: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3; it gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies.
Use the Snap Gun on a store's locked back door; kicking it in sets off the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and empty the safe.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
Leave without being spotted; if someone sees you, reload and try again.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open with an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4.

steps.text: Finish the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is; it introduces bank vault robberies.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip into the vault while the guard has it open.
Bring your partner — the cash is too heavy for one character, so hand off a bag with hold Right.
Rob any 5 of the 8 vaults; the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000.
Vaults always give a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognised.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank vault job counts — or blow a truck's doors open yourself.

steps.text: Robbing a bank vault in That's Where The Money Is counts as robbing an armored truck.
Earlier, you can box in an armored truck, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open.
The trophy pops only after you escape the red heat zone, or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the whole map.

steps.text: Fly over every part of the map that is still covered in black fog until it is all visible.
A plane is the fastest way to unfog the map; you can get one early in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops once no fog is left on the map.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.

steps.text: Rob one illegal gang operation from each of the 9 gangs; they show as yellow icons on the map.
Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs; the bottom right shows how many of their operations you robbed.
The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx confirms the method; other lists had not caught up at last check.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini at the rooftop bar.
Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view over Ocean Beach.
PowerPyx confirms this method in its updated guide; GTABase and Six Shore still listed the trophy as unconfirmed at last check.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: steal the blue Banshee and drive it through the window.

steps.text: First get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee.
Clone the key, then drive forward straight through the showroom window; the trophy pops a moment later.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling.

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2.
Take the luxury watch in the south-east office and the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table.
Loot the safe in the north-east hallway; bring sticky bombs to blow it open.
The trophy pops once you escape the police; you do not need all three valuables in one visit — the robbery comes back later.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.text: Check Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the character's Strength row.
Work out at fitness clubs with your partner along; while one trains, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles.
You can only switch between both characters after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; after the story you can also train at home.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. It fills up on its own if you play normally.

steps.text: Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, to see each action land.
Robberies and fights feed it, so it comes naturally; avoid pushing toward the permanent Irredeemable profile.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. PowerPyx believes it involves the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — no verified method exists yet.

steps.text: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx believes it involves robbing the same Payday Loans store from the Prologue again as Lucia, then getting away on foot, earliest after Chapter 3's Credit Check.
No verified unlock exists yet; treat the belief as a lead, not a guide.

audit.reason: No verified unlock method exists yet; PowerPyx's belief is noted in the guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness the UFO encounter in Kelly County after 2AM. Two player videos confirm it.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1, then go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2AM in-game, alone.
Look for a stranded car with flashing headlights at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back — the event is slightly random.
Follow the trail from the car into the woods, toward the blue light.
Talk to the woman the UFO drops, agree to help her, and go back to fetch her car from the road.
The UFO returns and abducts your character; the trophy pops and you wake up three in-game days later.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed. PowerPyx believes it involves kicking people from a motorcycle — no verified method exists yet.

steps.text: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx believes it is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by.
No verified unlock exists yet; treat the belief as a lead, not a guide.

audit.reason: No verified unlock method exists yet; PowerPyx's belief is noted in the guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. It adds up across robberies.

steps.text: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one job.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos get you there fastest.

steps.text: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops; it is a running total.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the most expensive, so they use the total up fastest.
Every shop type counts — mod shops, Pay 'n' Sprays, Ammu-Nations, clothing, footwear, salons, tattoo studios and electronics.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties for about $160,000 in total.

steps.text: Buy the 8 purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, about $160,000 in total.
The app arrives after Daily Driver in Chapter 2; you get a notification when it is installed.
The 4 garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 for sale.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Buy garages first — each one adds parking space.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; it lets you register stolen vehicles.
Buy garages first (see Little Boxes); each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray, then Register.
At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too. Use cheap cars to keep costs down.

audit.reason: Doable in free roam after the story; nothing about it is missable.
